hero.title: One Plan For Every Stage Of Growth
hero.subtitle: Start free, scale with confidence, and keep scheduling performance predictable as your team expands.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: For individuals and very small teams launching operations.
highlights: Access to community hub (1 Month Free)

plans.name: Professional
plans.description: For growing teams that need stronger automation and analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: For multi-team organizations with complex workflows and compliance.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan from billing settings anytime.

items.question: Do you offer annual billing?
items.answer: Yes. Annual billing reduces total cost and is ideal for stable operations teams.

items.question: Is there onboarding support?
items.answer: Professional and Enterprise plans include guided onboarding and best-practice setup.
